import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Basic

theorem lg_target (n : ℕ) : 6 ∣ n * (n + 1) * (n + 2) := by
  have : 2 ∣ n * (n + 1) * (n + 2) := by
    -- Among three consecutive integers, at least one is even
    rcases n with | 0 | (n+1) => 
      exact dvd_zero 2
      exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left_right 2 2 (dvd_refl 2) (dvd_refl 2)
  have : 3 ∣ n * (n + 1) * (n + 2) := by
    -- Among three consecutive integers, at least one is divisible by 3
    rcases n with | 0 | (n+1) => 
      exact dvd_zero 3
      exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left_right 3 3 (dvd_refl 3) (dvd_refl 3)
  exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left_right 2 3 (by sorry) (by sorry)
